purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: UP BhuNaksha is a real first-party cadastral map service with Modinagar tehsil metadata, EPSG:32644 extent responses, and safe native plot identifiers/bounding boxes. Its current full polygon endpoint rejected the anonymous request with HTTP 403, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Nagar Palika Parishad Modinagar is the evidenced local municipal custodian; the UP Board of Revenue/BhuLekh and BhuNaksha services are state cadastral custodians. This does not establish citywide open parcel-vector availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipal site identifies the local body and property-tax/public-service context; no parcel geometry API was exposed.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Government of Uttar Pradesh cadastral map viewer
officialPrimarySources.observation: Current public viewer configuration and service routes expose District/Tehsil/Village selection and map/plot operations.
